name: xgo-incremental-source-graph-refresh
instr:
xgo cannot reuse unchanged parsing and generation work across source revisions or identify the exact revision behind published results. Implement revision-aware incremental refresh without changing full parsing, explicit generation, filenames, filtering, diagnostics, or project selection.

Every local, FileFS, and map-backed `FileSystem.Snapshot(dirname) (Snapshot, error)` must capture comparable content and membership. `Diff(previous, current) ([]Change, error)` must return deterministic, path-ordered changes and no completed revision after snapshot failure. From `github.com/goplus/xgo/parser/fsx`, expose `Revision`, `SourceEntry`, `Snapshot`, `ChangeKind`, `Change`, `Diff`, and `FileSystem.Snapshot`. FileFS snapshots must represent one captured logical source regardless of requested directory or filename. Disk-backed instances must reflect bytes captured at construction. Handle slash-based map paths, missing paths, and content changes regardless of timestamp precision.

From `github.com/goplus/xgo/parser`, expose `NewIncrementalParser(fsys, dir, conf)` and make `(*IncrementalParser).Refresh()` reconcile additions, modifications, removals, and package moves. `RefreshResult.LastSuccessful() (fsx.Revision, map[string]*ast.Package, bool)` must retain the prior coherent graph after failed revisions. Match full parsing for source classification, configured filters, absolute filename identity, diagnostics, token positions, and package contents.
